decision: Break-glass must be used only where automation cannot execute the change.
why: An unrestricted role with no usage boundary becomes the fast path, and the repository stops being the record.

links.note: Stack deny assignments override role actions, so break-glass reaches platform resources by being excluded from them.
Policy denies apply regardless of role actions, so break-glass cannot deploy an unapproved resource type.

violations: Break-glass used for a change a pull request could have made.
